contract: A23-113: three one-row quests for first meetings, the frame of the daily jobs' D0 (no popup, no toast, no Start / Finish, one talking row, a minute of hunting): TS1 'Moving a Plus' (Requires.Seen ScrollMet: a transfer scroll in the bag), SZ1 'The Size Scale' (Seen ScaleMet: the player's own SizeMult above 1), SG1 'The Grudge Sack' (Seen SackMet: a PvP KO with info.Stolen > 0, for the thief and the victim). A meeting is saved in data.Story.First first and stays; Requires.Seen = that flag. The words follow Config.Grudge.SackSeconds (45 s) and Config.Justice.MaxScale (1.6).
limitations: Whether a real SizeMult is above 1 and whether PvPService really sends info.Stolen are the services' own tests; the dialogue panel and the row look are game dev 1's (the same D0 row frame).
